subject.title: feat(dashboard): add unlisted OpenClaw Bay demo

question: Should the production dashboard Worker expose this public-but-unlisted experimental Bay experience?
rationale: The branch introduces a substantial new public dashboard surface and presentation model; tests can establish safety and correctness, but they cannot authorize the product and rollout direction.

options.title: Sponsor the unlisted demo
options.body: Publish `/bay-demo` after the proof and check gates clear, while keeping it experimental and absent from ordinary navigation.

options.title: Keep the prototype external
options.body: Do not deploy the route on the production Worker until maintainers decide to adopt it as a supported experiment.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the unlisted demo
recommendation.body: Publish `/bay-demo` after the proof and check gates clear, while keeping it experimental and absent from ordinary navigation.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository history shows the strongest ownership of the dashboard Worker, operational status surfaces, and deployment smoke path.
